title: Media player: share data with a global singleton
line: Media keys now control the player you picked in the Media Player widget, even when another app starts playing.
explanation: The global media shortcuts live in kded's mprisservice, which has its own Multiplexer that always picks the playing (or last playing) player. The player chosen in the Media Player widget only existed inside plasmashell, so after choosing Strawberry, a Firefox video that started playing (or was last playing) still received the media keys. Choosing a player in the widget now sends it to kded over D-Bus (new setActivePlayer on /modules/mprisservice); kded keeps that player as the shortcut target until another tab is chosen, the automatic (star) tab is chosen again, or the player closes.

commits.message:
libkmpris: make media keys follow the player chosen in the widget

kded picked the target of the global media shortcuts on its own, so the
keys could control another player than the one chosen in the widget. The
widget now tells kded its choice, kept until changed or the app quits.

BUG: 460771
